review_comments:
MySQL:
```
Result of weight_string() was larger than max_allowed_packet (67108864) - truncated
```

In MySQL8, it is 
`Result of cast_as_binary() was larger than max_allowed_packet (67108864) - truncated`
The sql of this issue is `"SELECT HEX(WEIGHT_STRING('ab' AS BINARY(1000000000000000000)))`.
`SELECT HEX(WEIGHT_STRING('ab' AS char(1000000000000000000)));` also casues `makeslice: cap out of range`.
OK, I have fixed it, PTAL.
